statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low because Monday demonstrated substantial mean reversion and fresh supplementary overnight context shows little net futures displacement, while granular live post-reopen NQ path detail remains limited.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The next material checkpoint is the 2026-09-15 12:30 UTC Empire State release followed by the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open; any re-escalation depends on observed persistent extension and failed retracements.
headline: Tail remains low after Monday repair; Tuesday data and cash open are the next path checkpoints
body: Monday’s Nasdaq decline was modest by the close after a much weaker opening phase, showing meaningful intraday repair. Semiconductor weakness, the 10-year yield’s 5% test and unresolved Saudi oil-supply disruption keep Stress extreme. Fresh delayed overnight context is near flat, but it is not sufficient to assert live NQ retracement structure.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock hours, Tail was elevated through the overnight and U.S. open, peaking at 32%, then fell as Monday delivered substantial intraday mean reversion. A late second leg briefly returned Tail to WATCH at 20:00 UTC before the 21:00 and 22:00 UTC assessments returned to low.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is low because Monday demonstrated retracement capacity and fresh overnight evidence does not establish persistent mean-reversion failure. Conditional risk rises into Tuesday’s 12:30 UTC Empire State release and 13:30 UTC cash open, peaking at 24% WATCH unless observed failed retracements justify a higher path-risk state.

forecast.analysis: Fresh supplementary context collected at 22:47Z showed delayed NQ and ES near flat with only small moves in VIX and crude futures. This is not live path evidence; granular post-reopen NQ retracement structure is not independently verified. Monday’s strong mean reversion keeps Tail low while cross-asset Stress remains extreme.
drivers: Fresh Finviz context at 22:47Z showed delayed NQ +0.04% and ES +0.06%.
